sloka: सत्य संधौ महाभागौ भ्रातरौ राम लक्ष्मणौ ।वयस्य भावम् संप्राप्तौ राज्य अर्हौ राज्य दायिनौ ॥४-३१-४५॥
transliteration: satya saṁdhau mahābhāgau bhrātarau rāma lakṣmaṇau ।vayasya bhāvam saṁprāptau rājya arhau rājya dāyinau ॥4-31-45॥

translations.english: 'Rama and Lakshmana, both the brothers venerable and true to their promise, have conferred on you sovereignty and have extended friendship.'
